name: Customer support triage
description: A support message comes in. Is it urgent? Which team gets it? How upset is the customer? Upset customers are offered a human.

urgent.instructions: Does this message need an answer today?

criteria.true: Money, access or a live system is affected now
criteria.false: A question or request that can wait

team.instructions: Which team should handle this message?

human.instructions: Would the customer accept a call from a person instead of an email?
